plugins.description: Manage and analyze Google Ads, Meta Ads, Instagram, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads and Microsoft Ads from Claude Code through Windsor.ai. Report on campaigns, keywords, search terms, quality score, impression share and cost per conversion, track Instagram post reach, saves and follower growth, and combine it all with GA4, Search Console, HubSpot, Salesforce, Shopify, Stripe and 350+ other sources. Pause or enable campaigns, change budgets, set Google Ads bids and bidding strategies, create Google Ads Search and Performance Max campaigns and responsive search ads, push negative keywords, build Meta Ads campaigns, ad sets, ads and lead forms, update Google Merchant Center products, publish Instagram posts, carousels, reels and stories, Facebook Page posts, videos and Reels, and LinkedIn and Google Business Profile posts, reply to, hide or delete Instagram comments, and reply to and moderate YouTube comments and update video details, with your confirmation before every change.
